short_description: [SPO-8460] Shopping cart SPARK unavailable due to simulation timeout back-end — customer unable to complete order of 75 items (next-day delivery required)
description:
Website (SPARK) shopping cart functionality + associate portal (cart view)

The customer SPARK ID 3641784 carefully searched for and selected 75 items on the website to prepare for a project starting the following day, and added them to his shopping cart. 
He wishes to order these for next-day delivery.

However, the shopping cart is no longer visible/accessible SPARK.
The cause appears to be a timeout in the simulation front-end<>backend , which is blocking cart availability while awaiting a response from the backend.

Impact:

The customer Jansen Huybregts Onderhoud Renovatie BV SPARK ID 3641784 user d.zwegers@jansen-huybregts.nl can no longer view the selected items or complete the order. All of the customer's search preparation time has been wasted...
Internal Customer Service Technische Unie are also unable to view or complete the cart via the associate portal — meaning no workaround is currently available.

Business impact:
This is a production-blocking issue for the customer: 
He will be unable to start his project on time due to the delivery delay. 
This puts the reliability of our service at risk and could result in customer churn if not resolved promptly.

Steps to reproduce / Observed behavior:

Customer adds items (75x) to the shopping cart on the website.
Upon returning to the cart, a timeout occurs in the simulation/backend communication.
The shopping cart fails to load/display — for neither the customer or customer service  via the associate portal.

Requested action:
Urgent investigation into the backend timeout in the cart simulation, and restoration of cart access, so the customer SPARK ID 3641784  user d.zwegers@jansen-huybregts.nl can still place the order (75 items) in time for next-day delivery.

short_description: SPO-9181   Bug – Unable to Edit Public Product Lists Created by Colleagues
description:
Users are unable to add, remove, or modify products in a public product list when the list was created by another colleague.

This occurs even when the user has the required permissions to edit public lists (EDIT_PUBLIC_LIST) or has administrator rights within the customer account.

Steps to Reproduce
- User A creates a product list.
Set the list visibility to Public.
- User B, within the same customer account, opens the public list.
- User B has EDIT_PUBLIC_LIST authorization or administrator rights.
- User B attempts to add, remove, or modify a product in the list.
Actual Behaviour

User B is unable to add  product to the list, despite having the required authorization or administrator rights.

Expected Behaviour

Users with EDIT_PUBLIC_LIST authorization or administrator rights should be able to add, remove, and modify products in public product lists, regardless of which colleague originally created the list.

Customer Impact

This prevents colleagues from effectively collaborating on shared product lists and can result in unnecessary duplication of lists, inconsistent list management, and support requests.

Documentation SPARK
https://sonepardigital.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DFSP/pages/3271196673/List+management+Sharing

short_description: (SPO-8897) - Inconsistent Restock Information Between PLP and PDP
description:
Inconsistent Restock Information Between PLP and PDP

Description
The expected restock date displayed on the Product Listing Page (PLP) differs from the information shown on the Product Detail Page (PDP) for the same product.

Steps to reproduce
- Search for or navigate to a product with a known restock date. (3067797)
- Check the restock information displayed on the PLP/SRP
- Navigate to the product detailpage and check the restock information on the PDP.
- Compare the displayed dates.

Expected result
The PLP and PDP should display the same and consistent restock date for the product.

Actual result
The PLP and PDP display different restock dates, creating uncertainty about when the product will be available again.

Customer impact
Inconsistent availability information can confuse customers and may lead to incorrect expectations about product availability and delivery.

Found on browser: Versie 151.0.7922.174 (Officiële build) (64-bits) Chrome
